registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Global control register for firmware-visible command supervision.

fields.name: safe_fallback_select
fields.description: Software-visible safety policy hint retained for compatibility with the documented control plane.

fields.name: max_cmd_pos
fields.description: Maximum signed actuator position command, represented as a 64-bit two's-complement value.

fields.name: min_cmd_pos
fields.description: Minimum signed actuator position command, represented as a 64-bit two's-complement value.

fields.name: max_cmd_rate
fields.description: Maximum signed actuator command rate, represented as a 64-bit two's-complement value.

fields.name: stale_timeout_cycles
fields.description: Number of clk cycles allowed without an accepted request before stale is reported.

fields.name: response_timeout_cycles
fields.description: Number of clk cycles allowed for request completion before timeout is reported.

registers.name: SEQUENCE_EXPECTED
registers.description: Expected sequence policy value used for replay and ordering checks.

fields.name: sequence_expected
fields.description: Expected sequence value for request validation.

registers.name: STREAM_VELOCITY_SETPOINT
registers.description: Firmware-programmed velocity metadata or setpoint field.

fields.name: stream_velocity_setpoint
fields.description: Velocity setpoint or metadata forwarded through the control plane.

registers.name: FAULT_MASK
registers.description: Fault policy mask visible to software.

fields.name: fault_mask
fields.description: Fault enable or mask bits for software policy handling.

init_sequence: Assert reset and wait for cfg_ready to indicate an idle control plane.
Program MAX_CMD_POS, MIN_CMD_POS, MAX_CMD_RATE, STALE_TIMEOUT_CYCLES, RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_CYCLES, SEQUENCE_EXPECTED, STREAM_VELOCITY_SETPOINT, and FAULT_MASK.
Clear CTRL.enable before configuration if the host sequence requires a quiescent setup.
Set CTRL.enable once the configuration is committed and software is ready to submit transactions.
polling_sequence: Poll STATUS until busy deasserts after a request or supervisory event.
Read STATUS after each transaction to determine accepted, rejected_stale, rejected_seq, timeout, clamped, and fault_summary conditions.
If fault_summary or timeout is set, inhibit further requests until software clears the fault condition externally and reinitializes sequence policy if required.

consistency_notes: All assumptions remain compatible with DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.
The register map uses the documented 64-bit cfg_addr/cfg_wdata/cfg_rdata control plane and does not invent a different bus protocol.
Every declared register is reachable through RTL decode.
No top-level or software-visible register is introduced beyond the documented control and status set.
